artifacts.summary: Fixed the shared git-ls-files false-clean defect in check-record-versioning.sh and check-task-references.sh via a new shared tracked-plus-untracked union enumeration library with loud stderr diagnostics, plus a repo-wide triage fix, redeploy, and a continuation-dispatch gate-3 manifest-registration follow-up.

completion_data.completion_summary: Extracted a shared git-corpus-enum-lib.sh (tracked-plus-untracked union enumeration, gitignored content still excluded) and wired both check-record-versioning.sh and check-task-references.sh to it, closing the PATH_SCOPE false-clean defect for both lints with three stderr-only diagnostics (untracked-inclusion count, per-file gitignored loud-skip, zero-enumeration notice). Added 10+22+17 passing fixture cases across a new and two extended test suites, corrected the inventory doc, redeployed, and triaged the one genuine new ADVISORY finding the fix surfaced (gate-cost-model.csv) at its generator source. Continuation dispatch (seq 18) resolved the one held-open gate-3 finding: ran sync-manifest-scripts.sh --write to add the missing gate-cost-model.csv entry to provides.scripts, confirmed the two previously-flagged excursion files were already committed, redeployed, and verified verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 3 PASS for core with no new finding.

memory_candidates.content: When authoring a NEW shell test suite under agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/ that resolves a deploy-tree-first/source-store-fallback subject (a script or library under test), use lib/common.sh's common_test_resolve_subject (mode "deploy-tree-first", deployed path, source-store path) plus common_test_declare_subject immediately after, rather than hand-writing an inline CANDIDATES-array for-loop. A repo-wide lint (lint-subject-resolution-declaration.sh) now requires this shape and flags the inline for-loop as an undeclared/silently-ordered subject-resolution site -- it exempts pre-existing files as 'migration-pending' but a brand-new file gets no such grace. Caught only by a post-redeploy verify-deploy.sh run, not by the test's own exit code, since the test still passes correctly either way; only the lint cares about the resolution SHAPE, not the test outcome.
